# Army Healing

Make the units of an army heal faster between turns while one of them knows a spell. Vanilla Heal does this for every unit that heals, and Healing Words for humans & hoburghers. The unit that knows it doesn't need to cast it. Each command goes on its own line in a [spell](spells.md).

### heal&lt;trait&gt;army [bypassnoheal] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #heal-trait-army .command data-toc-label="heal&lt;trait&gt;army" data-added="3.0" }

Makes the units with the trait in the caster's army heal half their maximum Hit Points a campaign turn, where they would heal a tenth. The caster must know the spell, with a path level that reaches the spell's level. To heal the undead in battle too, declare a copy of the vanilla Heal weapon ("Weapon Data" in the [CoE5 Data thread](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1606340/discussions/1/3198114142283463845/)) with `affectundead` in place of `inanimate`. Name that weapon in the spell's `weapon` line.

- **trait:** One of the [vanilla traits](#vanilla-traits), or an ability command (["Monster Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=14)), as [`onlyaffects`](weapon-traits.md#onlyaffects) takes it. `heallivingarmy` and `healhumanarmy` are vanilla's and take no `bypassnoheal`: for humans that never heal, write `healarmy human bypassnoheal`.
- **bypassnoheal:** Also heals the units with the trait that have `noheal`, which otherwise never heal. Half the vanilla undead have `noheal`, the Longdead among them, so `healundeadarmy` heals them only with `bypassnoheal`.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    healundeadarmy bypassnoheal
    ```

    Or another trait, without bypassnoheal:

    ```c5se
    healanimalarmy
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@healundeadarmy bypassnoheal
    ```

    Or another trait, without bypassnoheal:

    ```c5m
    #!@healanimalarmy
    ```

### healarmy &lt;trait&gt; [bypassnoheal] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #healarmy .command data-toc-label="healarmy" data-added="3.0" }

Does everything [`heal<trait>army`](#heal-trait-army) does, and also takes custom [tags](monster-traits.md#tag).

- **trait:** One of the [vanilla traits](#vanilla-traits), an ability command, or `tag "<name>"`, as [`onlyaffects`](weapon-traits.md#onlyaffects) takes it.
- **bypassnoheal:** Also heals the units with the trait that have `noheal`, which otherwise never heal.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    healarmy undead
    ```

    Or a tag your monsters carry:

    ```c5se
    healarmy tag "Nazgul" bypassnoheal
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@healarmy undead
    ```

    Or a tag your monsters carry:

    ```c5m
    #!@healarmy tag "Nazgul" bypassnoheal
    ```

### Example spells { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newspell "Hands of the King"
    path "White Magic"
    level 2
    weapon 4 "Heal"
    heallivingarmy
    healhumanarmy

    newweapon "Shadow of the Necromancer"
    trgrank -9
    range 8
    init 4
    dmgtype 26
    aoe 1
    an
    affectundead
    onlyfriend
    look 38
    sound 89

    newspell "Sorcery of Dol Guldur"
    path "Necromancy"
    level 2
    weapon 10 "Shadow of the Necromancer"
    healundeadarmy bypassnoheal
    healarmy animal
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newspell "Hands of the King"
    #!@path "White Magic"
    #!@level 2
    #!@weapon 4 "Heal"
    #!@heallivingarmy
    #!@healhumanarmy

    newweapon "Shadow of the Necromancer"
    trgrank -9
    range 8
    init 4
    dmgtype 26
    aoe 1
    an
    affectundead
    onlyfriend
    look 38
    sound 89

    #!@newspell "Sorcery of Dol Guldur"
    #!@path "Necromancy"
    #!@level 2
    #!@weapon 10 "Shadow of the Necromancer"
    #!@healundeadarmy bypassnoheal
    #!@healarmy animal
    ```
